prompt: Rewrite the following as a warm thank-you note without exaggeration: 'You watered the plants while I was away. The basil looks better than before. You also noticed the window was leaking. I appreciated the message and the towel you put there.' Aim for about 80 words.
text: Thank you so much for taking care of the plants while I was away. The basil looks even healthier than when I left, and I really appreciate the attention you gave it. I’m also grateful that you noticed the window was leaking and let me know. Putting a towel there was thoughtful and helped keep the water from causing a bigger mess. It was reassuring to come home and see that everything had been looked after with such care.
